description: Mock implementation of Visual Studio Code API classes and types for testing purposes, including Position, Range, Uri, Selection, and workspace utilities.

classes.name: Position
classes.description: Represents a position in a text document with line and character numbers.

classes.name: Range
classes.description: Represents a range in a text document with start and end positions.

classes.name: Uri
classes.description: Represents a Uniform Resource Identifier with parsing and string conversion methods.

classes.name: Selection
classes.description: Represents a text selection, extending Range with anchor and active positions.

methods.name: isEqual
methods.description: Checks if two positions or ranges are equal.

methods.name: isBefore
methods.description: Checks if this position is before another.

methods.name: isAfter
methods.description: Checks if this position is after another.

methods.name: isBeforeOrEqual
methods.description: Checks if this position is before or equal to another.

methods.name: isAfterOrEqual
methods.description: Checks if this position is after or equal to another.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a position or range is within this range.

methods.name: fsPath
methods.description: Returns the file system path of the Uri.
